subject: Aligning multi-region demo during clock-change week
messages:
From: Tim Burton <tim.burton@brightbank.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@brightbank.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -0400
Subject: Demo: Redwood Inference — multi-region pilot (timing)

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. BrightBank is ready to see Redwood in action — we want a short, focused demo for the pilot stakeholders across Americas, EMEA, and APAC.

High level:
- Audience: Prod owners (US/NY), Data platform lead (London), APAC integrations (Singapore)
- Goals: latency/cost overview, routing/fallback behavior, and a short Q&A (~15 mins)

Given the teams span multiple regions, can you propose 2–3 time options next week? Important note from our side: we have some folks traveling the week of Mar 14 and flagged the DST changeover in the US — they asked whether that could cause confusion for calendar invites.

We attached a short scope doc for context (BrightBank_prod_scope.pdf).

Thanks — feel free to loop in whoever should present the infra/ops bits.

—Tim
Tim Burton
Director, Platform Engineering | BrightBank
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Tim Burton <tim.burton@brightbank.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Demo: Redwood Inference — multi-region pilot (timing)

Hi Tim — thanks for the scope and the heads up on the travel/DST callout. Quick notes and two coordination options below.

Short answer on DST: the US moved clocks on Sun Mar 14 (second Sunday). The EU won't move until Mar 28. That one-week offset can make "same-time" invites show different local times for EMEA attendees depending on calendar client. We should explicitly state time zones in invites and, to be safe, offer either split sessions or staggered sessions that cover all stakeholders without relying on a single crossing time during the mismatch window.

Option A — Two short sessions (recommended):
- Session 1 (EMEA/APAC friendly): 2027-03-22 14:00–14:45 UTC (15:00 CET / 23:00 SGT) — ops + integration deep-dive for London & Singapore
- Session 2 (Americas): 2027-03-22 17:00–17:45 UTC (13:00 EDT / 10:00 PDT) — product + executive summary for NY/Pacific stakeholders

Option B — Single rotating session + recording:
- One session at 15:00 UTC (11:00 EDT) — but expect late-night for APAC; record and send recording + brief tailored follow-up notes per region.

I've CC'd Mina from CS (coverage and recording) and Hannah from Solutions (tech & routing). Mina/Hannah — can you confirm availability for the proposed times and whether we should build a short per-region agenda? I can also send separate calendar invites that explicitly list local times (e.g., "2027-03-22 13:00 EDT / 18:00 GMT+1") so clients don't get confused by their calendar conversions during this DST offset week.

Attaching a draft agenda we can iterate on (redwood-demo-agenda-split-sessions.docx).

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Burton <tim.burton@brightbank.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Demo: Redwood Inference — multi-region pilot (timing)

Thanks Marcus — I can cover both sessions but prefer Option A so each region gets targeted time and we avoid the DST ambiguity. Proposed minor tweaks:

- Move Session 1 start to 2027-03-22 13:30 UTC (14:30 CET / 22:30 SGT) so London has a slightly earlier overlap with APAC engineering.
- Keep Session 2 as proposed but add a 10-minute buffer at the end for quick follow-ups and calendar action items.

I'll own invites and recordings. Marcus — can you confirm which demos we should record in full vs highlight clips? Tim — is there a preferred recorder or internal storage (Secure Share vs BrightBank Drive)?

—Mina
Mina Haddad
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Tim Burton <tim.burton@brightbank.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@brightbank.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 13:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Demo: Redwood Inference — multi-region pilot (timing)

Marcus / Mina — thanks, Option A + Mina's tweaks sound great.

Please send two calendar invites (separate events) and include explicit local-time notation in the title and body. We prefer recordings uploaded to BrightBank Drive (Aisha will share a folder link once invites are set). Also: can you include a 3-slide summary for Execs in the Americas session (performance, failover, cost delta)? Hannah — would you be able to prepare that short deck?

Look forward to it.

—Tim
